items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Lester Young in the context of the interviewer's preferences ('you liked Lester Young') and as a historical figure associated with the location of the interviewee's basic training ('where Lester Young not so long before had had his horrible experience'). No personal interact

ctx.x: When I met you, you liked Lester Young and Dizzy Gillespie. There were a lot of people you liked then.

items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You used to tell me stories about how they called him “Count No-Count,” when he’d be hanging around the town.

ctx.x: Oh, after we were married and we went back. I thought... You used to tell me stories about how they called him “Count No-Count,” when he’d be hanging around the town.

Yeah. They used to call him that. He started out working at fuel consumption something...I don’t know...at the University of Mississippi... I don’t know anything about him. I used to see him sometimes at the beer place.
